en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a waterfront bathing facility with wooden piers, small cabins, and a tall wooden diving or lookout tower built out over the water. The structure sits by a forested shoreline, with additional buildings faintly visible in the distance on the left. The caption is printed in the lower center, and a publisher credit appears in the lower left corner.
